title: Ensure force pushing code to branches is denied
description: A force push can erase the commits that reviewers approved and replace them with different code under the same branch. It destroys the audit trail that every other source control check depends on.
remediation: Repository settings -> Branch permissions -> Add restriction: select the default branch and enable "Prevent rewriting history". Configure it at Project settings -> Branch permissions to cover every repository in the project.
fixSummary: Enable "Prevent rewriting history" at Repository settings -> Branch permissions.
